notAcceptance: Backend, PostgreSQL and authorization are NOT exercised: API responses are network stubs.

results.description: administrator lands on the live queue; no synthetic preview text; read requests only
queue values and overnight time in the saved zone (browser zone America/Los_Angeles)
open case shows ELIGIBLE / INELIGIBLE / NOT_APPLICABLE as text, separate counts, no decision controls
filters, sorting and pagination send the documented server parameters; refresh keeps URL state
pagination: next/previous page requests, page count, empty page beyond the last page, back to page one
case changed while open: refresh shows the authoritative state and the closed case is not pending
EMPLOYEE gets no administrative request; invalid and unknown case ids are safe
network interruption shows a safe error and retry recovers
API 401 leaves the protected view (sign-in form), API 403 denies and revalidates the session
API 404 for a hidden project filter gives a neutral message and a way out; unknown case gives unavailable
invalid response and impossible timestamp are rejected without a page error
empty company shows the empty state; project list failure offers a retry
case page: page beyond the last one keeps the status filter and returns to page one
keyboard: links receive visible focus; no horizontal page scroll at 390px; table rows labelled
console: no uncaught page errors during the run; console error categories recorded
